experiments.description: Voiceover (offline Kokoro voices: Indian-English hf_alpha + American af_heart, af_bella, am_michael, am_fenrir, am_puck, rotated per video) on half of new videos
experiments.hypothesis: Narration lifts 48-hour views by at least 10% (owner's call, 2026-10-16)
experiments.notes: Started by the owner. maxDays 21 because uploads are manual until the YouTube audit. On keep: make Video.narrated true whenever the script has voice lines (drop the flag check in renderer/engine/video.py), make the writer always write `voice`, then remove this experiment. On revert: remove this experiment; the voice code can stay unused.
experiments.result: Closed without a verdict: the owner made every video voiced on 2026-10-17 (CLAUDE.md, hard constraints), so there is no off-arm. config/experiments.json no longer runs it.

experiments.description: A count-up or bar must land on the string Python makes from the number it counts to; its value is an @maths reference or 0, never typed.
experiments.evidence: Research 2026-10-18: v-20261017-04 (old engine) showed ₹6.5 L vs ₹6.4 L and ₹16.3 L vs ₹16.5 L for the same quantities. All 3 examples and v-20261018-01 pass the new check.

experiments.description: The render step gives a script with no narrator, or the previous video's narrator, the voice in NARRATOR_VOICES its format used longest ago (never-used first), and saves it in script.json.
experiments.evidence: Research 2026-10-19: am_michael narrated v-20261017-02, v-20261018-01, -02 and -03 (three in a row on one day); CLAUDE.md requires voices rotated per video. With current history the next Short gets am_fenrir, the next long video am_michael.

experiments.description: Long videos: the music bed about 4 dB lower and nearly silent under speech, so it only fills the pauses
experiments.hypothesis: Casual Finance's long videos (0.5-2.3M views) have no music bed at all (measured 2026-10-19: true silence between sentences, voice 35 dB over the floor; ours ~13 dB). A quieter bed keeps attention on the narration and lifts average % viewed.
experiments.notes: Started by the owner after the Casual Finance style study (improvement/style-study/2026-10-19-casual-finance.md). On keep: make QUIET_LEVEL/QUIET_DUCK the long-video default in build.py and remove the flag. On revert: remove the branch.

experiments.description: The writer's first line voices the on-screen hook (question or figure) within 8 words, no warm-up opener
experiments.hypothesis: v-20261018-02 showed 'Is your savings account keeping up?' at frame 0 while the voice said 'Quick question about your savings.' (1.8 s, no stakes). Saying the stakes in the first second keeps more viewers past the swipe and lifts 48 h views.
experiments.notes: Prompt-only (writer). On keep: fold the rule into generator/prompts/writer.md and add a check_script rule. On revert: drop the prompt.

experiments.description: The render step never gives the narrator the voice of a cast member who speaks in the same script (Sharma am_fenrir, Sikka af_bella); it takes the least recently used other narrator.
experiments.evidence: Research 2026-10-20: v-20261018-04 and L-20261018-01 had narrator am_fenrir while Sharma (am_fenrir) also spoke.

experiments.description: Prop 'stack': bills sit at half the old spacing and the figure rides just above the top bill, clear of a kicker and inside the frame under a punch.
experiments.evidence: Scout/Studio 2026-10-19: L-20261019-01 beat 'total' drew kicker and figure on top of each other, and without the kicker '$11,638' left the frame. Reproduced in stills before the fix (long and Short); after it both separate and the layout probe passes.

experiments.description: The number check ignores a leading m:ss / h:mm:ss timestamp on lines of a long video's description; numbers after it are still checked.
experiments.evidence: Studio 2026-10-19 had to run number-check before adding chapter timestamps, leaving the shipped description unchecked.

experiments.description: New maths kinds sip_stepup (yearly step-up vs flat SIP) and loan_prepay (prepay: lower EMI vs shorter loan), each recomputed in closed form by the number check; example examples/short_story_prepay.json.
experiments.evidence: Scout backlog (template/high): feed topics on step-up SIPs and EMI-vs-tenure prepayment could not be told with sip/emi. 5,382 random input sets: figures agree except 8 half-unit rounding edges on prepayments in a loan's last months (the number check rejects those; the writer picks other inputs).

experiments.description: New maths kinds real_return (growth vs inflation, in today's money), price_rise (a monthly cost rising yearly) and income_tax_bands (tax by bands, optional second income), each recomputed by an independent closed form in the number check; example examples/short_story_tax.json (UK frozen allowance).
experiments.evidence: Research template/high (19 and 21 Oct): the feed had inflation topics (US CPI energy, UK price cap) and the UK Budget frozen-allowance topic with no computed kind. 1,500 random input sets: maths and number check agree on every figure.

experiments.description: number-check warns (estimated timing) and render logs (measured timing) every Shorts beat over 5 s with more than 3 s between named events; a warning, not a failure, plus a writer note in short_story/README.md.
experiments.evidence: CLAUDE.md: a new picture every 3-5 s in Shorts. Measured on the last 10 Shorts' timelines: 30 beats over 5 s have a 3.2-5.8 s gap with no event (longest 5.8 s, v-20261021-02 'frozen'). Kept as a warning because headline/source scenes animate on their own and may be false positives.

experiments.hypothesis: A title naming a lived moment brings viewers who recognise the situation and stay: higher average % viewed than an abstract-claim title.
experiments.description: Shorts: titles name who and the everyday moment (a shopkeeper, a payslip, a dealer's offer), not an abstract claim about money
A stage chip with at "start" shows at 0 s (kit.tsx at()), and the video's first beat draws its chip fully from frame 0; check_script warns when a video opens on a stage with no chip.
experiments.evidence: videos/v-20261021-04/preview.png: the 0.0 s still had no chip; the script's 'Raise: {rich_amount} a month' chip popped in at the 0.4 s default because "start" was not an event. 3 of 19 openings use a stage chip with at "start". Re-rendered still at 0 s now shows the chip. CLAUDE.md: first frame hooks.

experiments.description: New maths kinds fee_take (a fee per period, per year, over N years, with a cumulative chart series) and compare (diff, ratio and % of two earlier results), each recomputed independently by the number check.
experiments.evidence: Scout template/high (21 Oct): rich vs poor and early vs late need the gap as one figure; both how_they_make_money topics need a swipe-fee figure. Tests cover closed forms and a wrong gap failing.

experiments.description: render_timeline empties work/stills and work/probe before rendering.
experiments.evidence: Scout (21 Oct): after L-20261021-01 got 30 s longer, preview.png still showed an end card from the earlier render and the probe kept 19 stale frames. Checked: a planted stale still is gone after a re-render.

experiments.description: check_script rejects two Test & Compare thumbnails with the same layout (and, for `story`, the same hero); long_story README documents the versus and secret layouts (also 2026-10-22-thumb-layouts-undocumented).
experiments.evidence: Scout (22 Oct): all three thumbnails of L-20261019-01/-02 and L-20261021-01 were layout story with one hero; YouTube's Test & Compare help says variants must be meaningfully different or the test ends inconclusive. Worked when thumbWinner is set (not inconclusive) for most long videos after 14 days.

experiments.description: state no longer offers a format whose best example is under MIN_VIEWS (100,000); check-plan names why a plan in one fails.
experiments.evidence: Research (23 Oct): cost_of_habit's only example is our own Short at 284 views, so any plan in it failed demand.views.

experiments.description: Prop scene: a counted figure (`value`) is hidden until its `at`, not shown as 0; on the video's first frame it shows in full.
experiments.evidence: Studio QA, L-20261021-01: tag/cheque/stack showed ₹0 for up to 6.5 s while the voice said the figure. Stills: vault with at 'out' shows nothing, then counts up.

experiments.description: Vault figure on a plaque above the door (gold bars inside); receipt shorter (top -0.72 s, 1.05 s tall) so its total lands above the caption band and its top clears a kicker (also 2026-10-21-receipt-in-caption-band).
experiments.evidence: Studio QA, L-20261021-01: the opened door hid ₹2,40,000 / ₹18,211 / ₹64.0 L; the receipt total sat under the captions. Stills long and Short: figures fully visible, layout gate clean.

experiments.description: Two-line charts shade the gap up to the drawing head and pop a chip with the gap's computed figure at `gap.at` (default: when the lines finish).
experiments.hypothesis: Rich vs poor and early vs late chapters are about the gap; showing and naming it raises average % viewed of long videos.

experiments.description: The writer ends the last beat on the hook's set at a wide shot (close-ups there at most 1 s)
experiments.hypothesis: v-20261022-01 held one close-up for its last 2.6 s before looping to a wide street shot, and v-20261023-01 ended on a close-up in a different set from its vault opening. Since March 2025 every replay counts as a view; a picture that returns to frame 0 should raise replays and % viewed.
experiments.notes: Prompt-only (writer). On keep: fold into generator/prompts/writer.md 'Loop it' and the short_story README loop rule. On revert: drop the prompt.
experiments.result: Evaluator 2026-11-02: revert (guard). QA/fact failures 18% on (2 of 11 attempts) vs 0% off (0 of 7); avg viewed 39.4% on vs 35.0% off, ratio 1.08, n 3 vs 2. Prompt removed from config.

experiments.description: Writer rule, fact-review reject reason and a description line: no narrator or cast line presents itself as an adviser or tells the viewer what to do with their money.
experiments.evidence: Research 2026-10-24 (high confidence): YouTube's monetization policy excludes content presenting itself as a human expert giving financial advice.

experiments.description: A shot on a stack frames its tag and label; a shot on a stack or phone zooms out just enough to keep it whole (camera.ts keepInside), also through the slow push.
experiments.evidence: Scout 2026-10-23: L-20261023-01 failed the layout probe on 30+ texts on close stack/phone shots. Test timeline: 6 off-frame texts before, the targeted stacks and phone whole after.

experiments.description: Long phone drawn 360 px wide (was 280: lines ~25 px, under the 30 px minimum); a label too long to share its row with the value goes above it.
experiments.evidence: Scout 2026-10-23: 'Market, assumed' ran into '8%' and phone lines failed the 30 px minimum.

experiments.description: The long frame's drop-in word drops 50 px with less spin instead of 260 px from above the frame.
experiments.evidence: Scout 2026-10-23: 7 words in L-20261023-01 failed the probe as off-frame mid-drop; Studio dropped them all.

experiments.description: The banknote's sign glyph is decoration (data-probe skip, like Sikka's coin), not text to read.
experiments.evidence: Scout 2026-10-23: the 20 px '$' on flying notes failed the probe; Studio removed every flow.

experiments.description: The manifest records `heard`: hookVoice (the voice of the first spoken line) and narratorShare (% of words the narrator speaks), so the voice ranking can follow what viewers hear. The ranking itself needs improvement/evaluate.py (owner-only): see notifications.
experiments.evidence: Research 2026-10-27: 'voice am_michael' is credited for v-20261021-05 and v-20261023-01, where the narrator speaks 15-16% of the words and Sharma most. On today's data, cast-first Shorts (hook voice am_fenrir, n=4) and narrator 0-24% of words (n=3) lead 48 h views.

experiments.description: list_explained videos may use a scene thumbnail as a third type, so Test & Compare gets three different types.
experiments.evidence: Scout 2026-10-26: L-20261026-01 could ship only two thumbnails (FORMAT_TYPES allowed grid or face, variants must differ).

experiments.description: render.json reports the timeline's tempo (1.4 Shorts, 1.5 long) instead of a fixed 1.0.
experiments.evidence: Scout 2026-10-21: L-20261021-01 and L-20261019-02 rendered at 1.5, render.json said 1.0.

experiments.description: A negative amount shows its sign before the currency (-$19,470, -₹15.0 L) in Python and the Remotion count-up, and the voice reads it as 'minus'. long_story README notes lumpsum takes a negative rate_pct.
experiments.evidence: Scout 2026-10-23: lumpsum at -15% gave gains '$-19,470'.

experiments.description: New maths kind `share`: total split among parts (per_part, parts as a count '8B'), and with per_year the years it takes to reach total. Independent check in generator/numbers.py; long_story README table.
experiments.evidence: Research 2026-10-28: money_scale/billionaire topics (2026-10-28-split-a-billionaire-with-everyone, 2026-10-27-a-billion-is-250-careers) need a division; writers bent fee_take with tiny percentages. Reference Shorts 204K and 32K this week.

experiments.description: Money at a trillion and up: USD/GBP/EUR short '$1.00T', long '$1 trillion', ticks '1T', counts '1.2T'; rupees from a lakh crore as grouped crore '₹1,00,000 Cr' / '₹1,00,000 Crore', ticks '1 L Cr'. Mirrored in remotion/src/fmt/inr.ts with parity fixtures; voice reads 'one trillion dollars', 'one lakh crore rupees'.
experiments.evidence: Scout 2026-10-28 (adopt/high): Money('USD').short(1e12) gave '$1000.00B' and INR '₹100000.00 Cr'; the 2026-10-28 billion topic shows a trillion.

experiments.description: Build scene camera: on 'all' frames every visible thing and every actor head to feet (keepInside the union); a shot on an item that catches part of an actor zooms out just enough to keep that actor's head (camera.ts keepHeads); an actor wholly outside stays out.
experiments.evidence: Scout 2026-10-28 (adopt/high): QA failed L-20261028-01 three times on headless actors at the edge of item and 'all' shots. Stills of that draft before/after: 7 of 19 sampled frames had a cropped actor before, none after.

experiments.description: Cast: in the facepalm pose an actor holds nothing (a prop carried from an earlier acting key no longer crosses the face); the prop returns with the next pose.
experiments.evidence: Scout 2026-10-28 (adopt/normal): QA, L-20261028-01 c5-currency and c3-change, phone drawn over Rohan's face.

experiments.description: check_script accepts a scene thumbnail without a figure (SceneThumb never draws one), so long videos can use the scene type FORMAT_TYPES offers.
experiments.evidence: Scout 2026-10-28 (adopt/normal): long scene thumbnails needed a figure that thumbs.py then fails; L-20261028-01 dropped to one thumbnail.

experiments.description: Things arrive (fly in from the nearer side or grow out of `from`, land with a squash), shake becomes a hop, and `flow` sends notes along an arc between two things with the figure riding on the lead note.
experiments.hypothesis: The owner rated the 31 Oct Shorts' animation 5/10 ('just popping up and shaking', 'very static'); the v-20261031-01 contact sheet shows money as small tags beside things that never move. Showing the route the voice describes gives the eye a moving target every beat and should lift % viewed.
experiments.notes: Code + writer prompt. Stills checked on v-20261031-01's timeline (flows in 'sale' and 'year', rent growing out of the owner): both arms pass the layout gate. On keep: drop the flag branches (keep the on-path) and move the prompt into SHOTS.md verbs and writer.md. On revert: delete the on-path and travel.ts use; keep the flow test documenting the gate.
experiments.verdict: Adopted by the owner on 2026-11-02 without waiting for the A/B ("fix them right now"): on for every Short; flag branches dropped.

experiments.description: The cinematic bed with a pulse: major-first progression, soft kick on 1 and 3 and a shaker from bar 1, snare on 2 and 4 from bar 3.
experiments.hypothesis: The owner found the cinematic bed 'very dull, like a postmortem' (v-20261031-02, E 94 BPM). Cinematic is our best genre (13.4x, 69.6% viewed, n=6), so keep it and add energy; % viewed should hold or rise.
experiments.notes: Built and tested 2026-11-02 (renderer/engine/music.py _cinematic_pulse, test_cinematic_pulse_keeps_the_level_and_adds_a_beat). Not running: experiments are at the cap of 5. Start it (status running + startedAt in both files) when a slot frees.
experiments.verdict: Adopted by the owner on 2026-11-02 without waiting for the A/B ("fix them right now"): on for every Short; flag branches dropped.

experiments.hypothesis: QA sent back the payoff of v-20261103-01 and -03 as 'mostly empty, reads only in the voice' (an empty disc held ~10 s), and every Short's last ~10 s carry no prop actions. Turn and payoff beats that act on their words keep viewers through the ending, where the loop decides replays: higher average % viewed.
experiments.description: Shorts: the coded Turn and Payoff beats act on their words and the ending's camera and transitions vary per video
experiments.notes: Prompt-only (writer). On keep: fold the rule into generator/prompts/writer.md and add a craft check for actions in custom turn/payoff beats. On revert: drop the prompt.

experiments.description: render.json audio records integrated loudness (BS.1770, LUFS) and how far the music sits under the voice; the render step warns outside -16..-13 LUFS or under 18 dB in a Short
experiments.evidence: Research adopt (confidence high): the 2026-11-02 quieter-bed mix had no measurement of whether it closed the ~13 dB vs ~29 dB gap to The Curious Plot. integrated_lufs matches ffmpeg ebur128 to 0.1 LU on test signals.
experiments.notes: metrics/videos.json does not carry the two fields yet: the ingest worker is the auditor's lane (notification).

experiments.description: Board rooms float things at 0.27 of the frame (over the cast's heads, was 0.2 at eye level); a thing's label over an actor steps above the thing
experiments.evidence: QA failed v-20261103-02 twice on the same scene bug (labels across Rohan's eyes and Priya's head, the bottle on his head). Stills before/after with the draft placement; layout and craft gates clean.

experiments.description: A build/board thing that nothing acts on until 0.6 s into the beat enters just before its first action instead of waiting on screen
experiments.evidence: Owner note on v-20261103-03 ('props coming before their context is said… make them appear and animate'): coffee, jet and bank sat on screen 1.5-2.5 s before their words. Stills after: the jar flies in on 'taxed'; layout gate clean.

experiments.description: The 'Data:' line prints once a video (first board beat that says a fact; own code via showsSource)
experiments.evidence: Owner note on v-20261103-01 ('source should be shown once only'): its Deal and Turn beats both printed it.

experiments.description: Craft check: at most 65% of a board video's actions may be marks (glow, stamp, bubble…)
experiments.evidence: Owner note on v-20261103-03 ('same stuff coming'): 71% marks; v-20261103-02 (his 'better animation' pick) 64%, -01 59%.

experiments.description: Writer: a real person gets one clause the first time they are named; a company is its name, never a pun object
experiments.evidence: Owner notes on v-20261103-02 (Buffett intro) and v-20261103-01 (Apple drawn as fruit, Google as a vault).
